title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a user can register successfully with valid data.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input valid username, email, and password.
Submit the registration form.
Check that the registration is successful and user is redirected or logged in.

title: User Registration Validation Errors
description: Verify that registration fails with invalid or missing input and relevant errors are displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Attempt to register with empty fields.
Check that validation errors for required fields are shown.
Attempt to register with invalid email format.
Check that email format error is shown.
Attempt to register with a password that does not meet criteria.
Check that password validation error is displayed.

title: User Login Success
description: Verify that a user can login with correct credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Submit the login form.
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to main page or dashboard.

title: User Login Failure with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify that login fails and error messages are displayed when incorrect credentials are used.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Enter incorrect username/email or password.
Submit the login form.
Check that login fails with appropriate error message displayed.

title: User Logout Functionality
description: Verify that user can logout successfully and session is terminated.

steps.description: Login to the application.
Click the logout button.
Verify the user is logged out and redirected to the login or homepage.
Attempt to navigate to an authenticated page.
Verify access is denied and user is redirected to login.

title: Video Upload Success
description: Verify video upload with valid video file and thumbnail is successful.

steps.description: Login and navigate to video upload page in Studio.
Select a valid video file and a valid thumbnail image.
Fill in video details: title, description, tags, category.
Submit the video upload form.
Verify the video is uploaded successfully and appears in user’s video list.

title: Video Upload File Validation
description: Verify that invalid file types or files exceeding size limits for video or thumbnail are rejected with proper messages.

steps.description: Attempt to upload a non-video file as video.
Verify rejection with appropriate error message.
Attempt to upload a video file exceeding maximum allowed size.
Verify rejection with file size error message.
Attempt to upload non-image file as thumbnail.
Verify rejection with appropriate thumbnail error message.

title: Video Edit Functionality
description: Verify users can edit video details and changes are saved and reflected correctly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to user’s uploaded videos in Studio dashboard.
Select an existing video to edit.
Modify fields like title, description, tags, category.
Submit the changes.
Verify that the changes are saved and displayed correctly in video details and listings.

title: Video Delete Functionality
description: Verify that users can delete their uploaded videos and videos are removed from listings.

steps.description: Login and navigate to Studio dashboard.
Select a video and initiate deletion.
Confirm the deletion action.
Verify the video is removed from user’s video list and not accessible.

title: Video Playback Loads and Increments Views
description: Verify that video playback works correctly, displays accurate details, and increments the view count once per user session.

steps.description: Navigate to a video playback page.
Verify the video player loads and begins playback.
Check that video metadata (title, description, views, likes) is displayed correctly.
Reload the video page.
Verify that the views count increments correctly only once per unique view session.

title: Search, Filter and Sort Videos
description: Verify video listing supports searching by keyword, filtering by tags and category, and sorting by views or date uploaded.

steps.description: Navigate to the video listing or main page.
Enter a search keyword and submit.
Verify that search results contain relevant videos matching the keyword.
Apply filters by tags and category.
Verify that only videos matching selected filters are shown.
Select sort option e.g. most viewed or newest.
Verify that videos are correctly sorted according to selection.

title: Comment Creation and Nested Replies
description: Verify that users can post top-level comments and nested replies on videos.

steps.description: Navigate to a video playback page.
Post a top-level comment.
Verify the comment appears correctly under the video.
Post a reply to the top-level comment.
Verify the nested reply is displayed correctly indented under the parent comment.

title: Comment Edit and Delete
description: Verify users can edit or delete their own comments and changes reflect correctly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to a video with user’s comment.
Edit a comment and submit.
Verify the comment text updates accordingly.
Delete the comment.
Verify the comment is removed from the comment list.

title: Comment Like and Dislike Functionality
description: Verify users can like or dislike comments, cannot vote multiple times, and vote counts update properly.

steps.description: Navigate to a video with comments.
Click like on a comment.
Verify the like count increments.
Attempt to like the same comment again.
Verify that the second like is prevented and count does not change.
Click dislike on a comment.
Verify dislike count increments and changes if user switches vote.

title: Video Like and Dislike System
description: Verify that users can like or dislike videos, cannot vote more than once, and counts update correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to a video playback page.
Click like button on the video.
Verify like count increases.
Try to like the video again.
Verify the like count does not increase further.
Click dislike button and verify like count decreases and dislike count increases as appropriate.

title: User Subscription and Unsubscription Flow
description: Verify users can subscribe and unsubscribe to other users and subscription feed updates accordingly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to another user's profile page.
Click subscribe button.
Verify subscription count increments and subscribed status is shown.
Navigate to subscription feed page.
Verify that videos from subscribed users are displayed.
Click unsubscribe button.
Verify subscription count decrements and user is removed from subscription feed accordingly.

title: User Profile Displays Correct Video Listings
description: Verify that user profile pages show accurate lists of videos uploaded by the specific user.

steps.description: Navigate to a user’s profile page.
Verify that all videos displayed are uploaded by that user.
Verify that video counts and other user info are displayed correctly.

title: Studio Dashboard Video Statistics Accuracy
description: Verify that the Studio Dashboard displays accurate aggregated video statistics such as total views and likes.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the Studio Dashboard.
Verify that views and likes counts reflect current database state accurately for each video.
Verify statistics update when video is viewed or liked.

title: Admin Dashboard Full CRUD Operations
description: Verify administrators can create, read, update, and delete users, videos, comments, and manage database entries correctly.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to Admin Dashboard.
Perform create, edit, and delete operations on users.
Verify changes are persisted and reflected in user list.
Perform edit and delete operations on videos and comments.
Verify video and comment listings update accordingly after changes.
Verify database management functionalities are accessible and functional.

title: RESTful API Endpoint Correctness
description: Verify that RESTful API endpoints for videos, comments, likes, and subscriptions return correct data formats and expected HTTP status codes.

steps.description: Send API requests to fetch video info.
Verify response returns expected JSON schema and HTTP 200.
Send API request to create or update a comment with valid data.
Verify successful response and comment creation.
Send API requests with invalid data or unauthorized access.
Verify appropriate error codes (400, 401, 403) and messages are returned.

title: File Upload Security and Validation
description: Verify that uploaded files are validated for type and size and are sanitized to prevent security vulnerabilities.

steps.description: Attempt to upload files containing scripts or malicious payloads disguised as media files.
Verify file upload is rejected or cleansed and no executable content is accepted.
Upload valid media files and attempt to upload unsupported file types.
Verify appropriate validation and security checks are enforced.

title: Dark Mode UI Toggle
description: Verify that users can toggle between dark mode and light mode UI themes and the preference is persisted during session.

steps.description: Navigate to any page with toggle control.
Toggle dark mode on.
Verify UI changes to dark theme (background, text colors).
Toggle dark mode off.
Verify UI reverts to light theme.
Refresh the page.
Verify the selected theme preference persists.

title: Responsive Design on Multiple Devices
description: Verify that the application layout and components adapt correctly across mobile, tablet, and desktop screen sizes.

steps.description: Open the application on desktop browser.
Verify layout and UI elements are correctly displayed.
Simulate or open the app on tablet screen size.
Verify UI components adapt and remain functional and readable.
Simulate or open the app on mobile screen size.
Verify navigation, buttons, videos, and comments display correctly and interaction is smooth.

title: Prevent Duplicate Likes on Videos
description: Ensure that a user cannot like a video multiple times and the like count reflects unique likes only.

steps.description: Like a video.
Verify that the like count increments by one.
Attempt to like the same video again.
Verify that the like count does not increment further and no error occurs.

title: Prevent Duplicate Likes on Comments
description: Ensure that a user cannot like a comment multiple times and like/dislike counts reflect unique votes only.

steps.description: Like a comment.
Verify the like count increases by one.
Attempt to like the same comment again.
Verify the like count remains unchanged.
Switch vote from like to dislike.
Verify like count decreases by one and dislike count increases by one.

title: API Unauthorized Access Handling
description: Verify RESTful API endpoints reject unauthorized requests with appropriate HTTP status codes.

steps.description: Send API requests without authentication token to protected endpoints.
Verify response status codes are 401 Unauthorized.
Send API requests with invalid or expired tokens.
Verify response status codes are 401 Unauthorized.

title: Session Management on Logout
description: Verify user session is properly terminated after logout and cannot access authenticated endpoints or pages.

steps.description: Login and navigate to a protected page.
Logout from the application.
Try to access the protected page again.
Verify user is redirected to login page and session data is cleared.

title: Input Sanitization on Comments to Prevent XSS
description: Verify that comment inputs sanitize HTML and scripts to prevent cross-site scripting attacks.

steps.description: Post a comment containing HTML and JavaScript code.
Verify that script tags are escaped or removed and not executed.
Verify the comment displays safely in the UI without security warnings or errors.
